A_original.name: A. Original rules
A_original.what: every confirmed breakout or breakdown, any stock in the universe

summary.label: A_original
summary.warning: A backtest is not proof of future results. Sample is small; see the day-by-day list before trusting any number.

B_strong_news.name: B. Strong stocks with real news
B_strong_news.what: longs only on stocks already up 10%+ on the day, 5x normal volume, a fresh verified catalyst (news or an SEC 8-K), and no dilution news or filings

summary.label: B_strong_news
summary.warning: A backtest is not proof of future results. Sample is small; see the day-by-day list before trusting any number.

C_strong_volume.name: C. Strong stocks, news not required
C_strong_volume.what: longs only on stocks already up 10%+ on the day with 5x normal volume and no dilution news or filings

summary.label: C_strong_volume
summary.warning: A backtest is not proof of future results. Sample is small; see the day-by-day list before trusting any number.

D_pullback_news.name: D. Strong + news, pullback entry
D_pullback_news.what: same stocks as B, but waits for the first pullback after the high of day that holds above VWAP, buys the turn back up, stop under the pullback low

summary.label: D_pullback_news
summary.warning: A backtest is not proof of future results. Sample is small; see the day-by-day list before trusting any number.

E_pullback.name: E. Strong, pullback entry, news not required
E_pullback.what: same stocks as C, with the pullback entry from D

summary.label: E_pullback
summary.warning: A backtest is not proof of future results. Sample is small; see the day-by-day list before trusting any number.

note: Same days, same data, same costs and fills for every variant. Every confirmed signal is taken (no day-trade limit) so each rule set is judged on enough trades.
